description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableSubject' implementing the 'Subject' interface, representing a subject with an ID and type, including JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: ImmutableSubject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subject interface, representing a subject with an ID and type, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Subject with the given SubjectId and default type GENERATED.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Subject with the given SubjectId and specified SubjectType.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Subject instance from a JSON object and issuer+ID string, extracting the 'type' field.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the SubjectId of this Subject.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the SubjectType of this Subject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subject to a JsonObject, including schema version and type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on subjectId and subjectType.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on subjectId and subjectType.
